turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
I can pass your tattoo booking request to a colleague. First, could you tell me the tattoo idea, its approximate size, where on the body you want it, and when you are available?
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.

Thank you. I have passed your request to a colleague: a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of your left forearm, available on weekday evenings. A colleague will take over from here and get back to you about the booking.

input.summary: Tattoo booking request. Idea: small paper boat. Size: about 8 cm wide. Placement: outside of left forearm. Availability: weekday evenings. No price or date given. Customer not tied to an order.
